csv_project_name: DB for Cheyenne Readiness Center Complex Microgrid
csv_scope_of_work: The Wyoming Military Department (WYMD) will receive statements of qualification consists of the design and construction of a secure microgrid system consisting of a 1-megawatt photovoltaic solar array, 4 megawatts of natural gas generators, and a 300kW/300kWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) to provide redundant electrical loads, and 9,500 million BTU geothermal field that will provide resilient and redundant HVAC loads for the Cheyenne Complex. The system will provide islanding capabilities to the installation from all outside energy sources ensuring that mission critical facilities maintain operations during outages, for a duration of 14 days.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering
